Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `voxprint_common-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl`: the official v0.3.0 release asset from https://github.com/Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common/releases/download/v0.3.0/voxprint_common-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl (tag commit 0b557179c736ab53297449c90e879ddf4256cea0; sha256 `70c7fa2bd0a63af20e7f91262b7d878a9ac3b7c3a2950c256b96982878e6aefd`, also in the `.sha256` sidecar). It bundles the serial 9 signed model index (index head 15edeab, sha256 104742f9…f49e45f), the voxprint-model/1 schema with `onnx_prebuilt` and `post_install` (schema sha256 08dc67f3…ec08), and our index public key (`keys/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.3.0`.
